Even last-moment flight bookings with preferred seats were managed efficiently, showcasing the team’s reliability and commitment.

We have been using Sanket Travels’ services since 2016, and every trip has been well-planned and worry-free. Highly recommended for anyone looking for personalized, dependable travel planning.

featured_reviews.name: Raghuspeaks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vietnam Trip Debrief: The Highs, the Lows, and the Unsung Hero

​Overall, this trip managed to hit a 5-star high, but that victory was hard earned against some serious turbulence. Here is the breakdown of what made the trip spectacular, and where things went entirely off script.

The Highs: Absolute Wins

​The Ultimate MVP (Tour Manager Megha Shinde): We struck absolute gold with Megha. She was the heartbeat of the tour, effortless and vibrant. She kept the group atmosphere lighthearted, and genuinely fun. Without her, this trip would have been a 3 star affair; she single-handedly elevated it to a 5-star masterpiece.

​The food across the board was phenomenal. Every single meal was a delicious highlight. Frequent Travellers will agree food in most foreign trip is deeply ignored.

​The hotel accommodations were fantastic. Clean spacious rooms welcomed us which is again a rare win for any traveler.

​The local guides, Khan, Micheal and Charlie were fantastic. They were not pushy like most local guides were have dealt in the past.

Our group though a bit noisy were incredibly disciplined, respecting schedules.

The Lows :  The Villain

​VietJet takes the crown for the absolute worst airline experience to date. The check-in counter staff were downright hostile.

Our trip started with a bad note with the airline putting my family of 3 in different corners of the aircraft, forcing us to pay extra just to sit together. This was a massive oversight on Veena World’s logistical planning.

​The local hospitality left much to be desired. The local attitude was surprisingly cold, rude and at times arrogant.

They hate the chinese but behaved like one (people who dealt with the Chinese will understand) exposing a racist and unfriendly demeanor.

On Day 1 Forcing sight-seeing immediately upon arrival before hotel check-in is a grueling design. Veena World needs to negotiate early check-ins so weary travelers can freshen up before hitting the streets.

Itenary on Departure Day also should be kept light.
We got incredibly lucky that the weather held out for our excursion to the Cu Chi Tunnels (something  I was looking forward being a history buff) which turned out to be an absolutely mind-blowing experience

A sudden downpour would have ruined it. Hence, the final day needs to be kept light and breezy.

To summarise ,
While most Lows need Vietnamese people to fix, if they want to truly flourish as a top-tier tourist destination, the logistical hiccups are entirely within Veena World's power to correct for future travelers.

​Ultimately, despite the flaws and airline headaches, Megha saved the day, turning potential disasters into a truly memorable vacation. If it was not for her, the smiles on the group would have been missing.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Leena Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Timeless Travels Team,

We would like to share feedback regarding our recent travel experience.

The food and water service during the journey requires significant improvement. Although water service was included in the travel plan, it was not provided as expected.

Additionally, we strongly advise against recommending AK Continental Hotel to future travellers. At this hotel, basin water was provided for drinking, which is completely unacceptable—especially from a hotel claiming a 4-star rating. Moreover, the bedsheets and pillows were not clean. Upon checking into the room, we found hair on both the bed and pillows, which was extremely unhygienic and disappointing.

Furthermore, the bus provided by Timeless Travels was not adequate for the number of people in the group. The seating was cramped and did not offer a comfortable travel experience.

We hope these concerns will be taken seriously and addressed promptly to ensure a higher standard of service for future trips.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Leena Ma'am and Respected Group Members,

First of all, We are glad that you chose our company for your most memorable trip and I hope you will keep on choosing our company for your future trips as well!😊

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We value every comment...positive or critical, as it helps us improve.

However, we would also like to share a few clarifications from our side:

Food and Water Service:
While we agree that certain areas can always be improved, water and food arrangements were made at every stop as per the itinerary. If there were any lapses during travel, we wish they had been communicated on the spot so we could have taken immediate corrective steps.


Hotel Concerns – AK Continental:
We completely agree that drinking basin water is unacceptable, and the hygiene issues raised are serious. We have already escalated this matter to the hotel management and will reconsider future bookings with them. However, before booking this property we have provided Hotel options in that category in peak season, and was chosen after comparing several properties.
Secondly, @⁨~Amit Bastav⁩ and @⁨~Lipika Vaity⁩ 
The vehicle we provided matched the number of members in the group as per the booking agreement. While it might have felt slightly congested at times, it was within the acceptable range of comfort for group travel.
As per conversation with Gitesh Sir and Driver carrier was provided in tempo traveller however, you choose to keep your belongings in Tempo traveller only.

We regret the miscommunication regarding Hidimba Temple. However, the driver did take the group there eventually, and everyone was able to enjoy the location and click memorable photos. We’ve noted the issue and will ensure drivers give better guidance in the future.

While no trip is ever 100% perfect, we put in sincere efforts to make your journey smooth, safe, and enjoyable. Most group members actively participated and enjoyed the tour, and we received many smiles and positive feedback during the trip!

We respect everyone's right to share their opinions, but we also request that the overall success and coordination of the trip be acknowledged fairly. Our commitment remains strong to continuously improve and offer memorable travel experiences!😊


Warm regards,
Team Timeless Travels
